A list of instrument components

Source: R/accessors.R
sf_component_list.Rd

The value returned by sframe_get_items(), sframe_get_scales(), sframe_get_choice_sets(), sframe_get_branches(), sframe_get_attention_checks() and sframe_get_models(). It is a list of component objects named by their IDs, so a single component is reached with [[.

Value

print() returns x invisibly. [ returns an sf_component_list.

Examples

item1 <- sframe_item("q1", "First question", type = "text")
item2 <- sframe_item("q2", "Second question", type = "text")
instr <- sframe_instrument("Demo", components = list(item1, item2))

sframe_get_items(instr)
#> <item list: 2>
#>  <sf_item: q1 | type: text>
#>  <sf_item: q2 | type: text>
sframe_get_items(instr)[["q2"]]
#> <sf_item: q2 | type: text>
#>   Label: Second question
